description: This file defines an Android service called MessengerService that uses the Messenger class to handle IPC communication with clients via messages. It manages client registration, message handling, and displays a persistent notification while running.

classes.name: MessengerService
classes.description: An Android service implementing IPC via Messenger to communicate with clients, register/unregister clients, set values, and show notifications.

classes.name: MessengerService.IncomingHandler
classes.description: Inner class extending Handler to process messages from clients.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager and shows a notification when the service starts.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the notification and shows a toast when the service stops.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the IBinder for clients to communicate with the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a persistent notification indicating the service is running.
